statements.status_notes: dompurify@3.2.4 appears in the SBOM as a residual entry from the alloy web UI build. The runtime code uses dompurify@3.3.2 which is patched. Additionally, dompurify is only used in alloy's embedded monitoring web UI for HTML sanitization; exploitation requires user interaction and authenticated access to alloy's HTTP interface.

DOMPurify XSS via SAFE_FOR_XML regex bypass affecting 3.1.3 through 3.3.1. Fix exists in source (commit 729097f) but no fixed version is published on npm yet. dompurify is used in alloy's embedded web UI for HTML sanitization. Exploitation requires user interaction and access to alloy's HTTP interface.
